Unknown motion cannot leave opacity zero; independent device/editor ownership and bounded nested sizing preserved.

individual_findings: Individually reviewed all 85 original settings and three presets. Both pin and panel loops use identical enabled/populated rules; every actual panel is readable and dead pin buttons hidden without JavaScript. Enhancement selects the first actual enabled pin, so disabled slot one cannot hide all content. Keyboard arrows/Home/End respect RTL; mobile/narrow views expose all panels with truthful expanded state, and focused content is protected during a collapse. Native image and authored panel-only states stay useful; coordinates are bounded away from clipped edges, long labels escaped, zero-minimum tracks and independent device/editor rules repaired. Pulses finish after two cycles and scoped resize/observer state is disposed on removal.

individual_findings: Individually reviewed all 61 original settings plus explicit caption color and translated price-range prefix controls, and three presets. Enabled items render only actual media/copy/actions or an allowed native product card; product-only content does not reserve a fake hero image, and disabling product cards removes otherwise empty slots. Native product URLs/titles/images/prices and explicit caption links remain distinct and safely rendered; variable native prices are labeled From and missing card imagery collapses its track. Image/overlay/caption share an in-flow grid cell, so long captions grow the media area instead of being clipped. Sparse grids avoid missing named areas and nested/mobile minimum heights actually win. All saved layout choices and merchant content preserved; new editorial claims removed.
